verification.intro: Every PDF from hocX can be checked on the public verification page – no account needed.
verification.showIdentityHint: When off, the verification page only shows that the document comes unchanged from hocX – not from whom.
verification.showNewerVersionHint: For minutes: if there is a newer version, its number is shown, but no content.
verification.revokedNameChanged: The verification was revoked on {date} because the name changed. You can request it again.
verification.revokedByAdmin: The verification was revoked by hocX on {date}.
verification.verifiedButHidden: Only shown when name and logo are visible.
verification.pendingSince: Request from {date} for “{name}”. hocX will get in touch if evidence is missing.
verification.requestMessagePlaceholder: e.g. commercial register entry, website or articles of association
verification.saveFailed: The change could not be saved.
verification.previewTitle: Live preview of the verification page
verification.previewText: Unchanged copy, created on {date} with hocX.
verification.previewNewer: There is a newer version (v1.3) of this document. The issuer can give you its content.
verification.domainNotBooked: An own verification domain is not part of your plan and can be added by hocX.
verification.domainPendingHint: Finish the DNS setup under Domains.
verification.domainHiddenHint: The verification domain is only used once name and logo are shown on the verification page.
verification.domainUnhealthyHint: The domain no longer points to hocX in DNS. Until this is fixed, new PDFs point to the hocX verification page.
verification.domainNotBookedHint: The feature “Own verification domain” is no longer part of your plan. New PDFs point to the hocX verification page.
verification.levelsIntro: The higher the level, the more certain recipients can be that the document comes from you.
verification.levelAuthenticityText: Recipients see whether a file comes unchanged from hocX.
verification.levelDomainText: Checks happen at your own address. Weaker than verification – anyone can register a domain.
verification.levelVerificationText: hocX confirms that this account belongs to your organisation.
verification.verifiedNameChangeNote: If the name changes, the verification is revoked.
verification.previewHidden: The issuer is not shown – only that the document comes unchanged from hocX.
